snippet.description:

Download https://frenzytimes.itch.io/broken-leash

Story
A night at Pet Haven Gloaming Bay pet store. The clock ticks slowly, the silence weighs heavily, and every corner of the store seems to be watching you.

What seemed like a routine shift soon becomes impossible to explain.

Explore with caution, trust your instincts, and remember: not everything you hear is from your imagination.
